headline: Approved $241,250 fund transfer for union negotiation retroactive costs, 2-0.
summary: The committee approved an FY2026 Inter Departmental Transfer of $241,250 from the Reserve for union negotiations to cover retroactive costs back to July 1, 2024, by a vote of 2-0. Members also discussed four retired workers affected by the transfer and agreed to send the matter to the full Council for discussion before returning it to Finance & Property.
decisions: Approved Order #088, an FY2026 Inter Departmental Transfer of $241,250 from the Reserve for union negotiations to fund retroactive costs back to July 1, 2024, 2-0.
Approved sending the matter to the full Council for discussion, 2-0.
